sample_unit: websites (source of keratoconus questions posed to chatbots)

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers to keratoconus questions versus recommended patient reading levels
links.effect: Readability often exceeded recommended levels; Gemini easiest to read, ChatGPT-3.5 and Perplexity most difficult; ARLC score 13.17 ± 2.13 for 'What is keratoconus?'
links.quote: However, their readability often exceeded recommended levels.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation comparing the quality, reliability (mDISCERN, GQS), and readability of six LLMs answering keratoconus questions for patients without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
